cl.label: Compensatory lengthening
cl.note: Where degemination lengthens the preceding vowel, read from the lengthening rule's environment.

sib.label: Sibilants
sib.note: The sibilant merger rule's output (s, ś, or partial), or none.

ks.label: kṣ
ks.note: Output of the kṣ cluster rule.

intstop.label: Intervocalic stops
intstop.note: Loss, voicing only, or retention of single intervocalic stops.

clusters.label: Cluster treatment
clusters.note: Assimilation to geminates (MIA type) vs simplification without geminates.

flap.label: Intervocalic ḍ
flap.note: Output of the flap rule (ṛ, r, ḷ, l) or none.

sh.label: s > h
sh.note: Debuccalisation of s, by conditioning environment (each is a different change).

nasal.label: Nasal + stop
nasal.note: Anusvāra → nasal vowel vs nasal consonant kept.

stress.label: Accent-conditioned rules
stress.note: Rules tagged @stress (conditioned on the Vedic accent).
